audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Lucian Level 6 and 2+ items and calls first item even, while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] all say Gwen takes 6, the Riftmaker spike and the scaling. Level 3 reads Lucian while its own why calls it 'a genuine coinflip'.
audit.why: Gwen wins this lane at 52.48%. Her mist and E stickiness beat a no-escape ADC from 6 onward — the prose already said so, the chart did not.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Lucian / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait his E dash' appears five times with no number, and Relentless Pursuit is by far the longest basic cooldown in the matchup.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — sixteen seconds at rank 1. That is an enormous punish window and the single most useful number on the page. Piercing Light is 9s at rank 1 and The Culling 110s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to whys, spike, mid and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Lightslinger attacks shorten Relentless Pursuit, so 'engage when his dash is down' is only half the rule.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' A Lucian who is allowed to keep hitting you gets his dash back early — the 16 seconds only hold if you deny him the double-shots. That is also the auto-reset tell: the double-shot follows every ability cast, so the ability is your cue, not the attack.
audit.corrected: Both stated in Key Ability Interactions and the cooldown breakdown.

edits.before: With Q poke and an E reset you can finally trade, but his auto range and E dash keep the lane a genuine coinflip until you spike.
edits.after: With Q poke and an E reset you can trade, but Piercing Light (9s) and a 16-second dash he is still holding keep it a coinflip.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist lets you bait his E, go untargetable as he commits, and slow-chase a flashless Lucian to a kill.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist lets you bait Relentless Pursuit, go untargetable as he commits, then slow-chase a dashless Lucian for 16s.

edits.before: You out-scale a no-escape ADC — your untargetability and stick beat his kite as long as you fight near walls with W up.
edits.after: You out-scale a no-escape ADC — untargetability and stick beat his kite as long as you fight near walls with W up.

edits.before: Hold Relentless Pursuit as disengage and dash out the instant you E in, kiting your melee range all lane
edits.after: Hold Relentless Pursuit (16s at rank 1) and dash out the instant you E in, kiting your melee range

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist lets you bait his E dash, go untargetable as he commits autos, then slow-chase a flashless Lucian with R into a kill.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist: bait Relentless Pursuit, go untargetable as he commits autos, then slow-chase him through its 16-second cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay his while you wait on W, but Level 6 flips it: now you bait his Relentless Pursuit dash, then drop Hallowed Mist the instant he commits double-shot or autos so they whiff on an untargetable you, and answer with R's slow plus passive healing. He's a squishy with no escape once E is down, so once you E in inside the fog with anti-heal up, your on-hits and Q burst end him fast. Make him use his dash defensively first, then go.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his while you wait on W, but 6 flips it: bait Relentless Pursuit — 16 seconds at rank 1 — then drop Hallowed Mist the instant he commits double-shot or autos so they whiff on an untargetable you, and answer with R's slow plus passive healing. He is a squishy with no escape once that dash is spent, so E in inside the fog with anti-heal up and your on-hits and Q burst end him. Make him spend the dash defensively first, then go.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, but his Lightslinger double-shots shorten it — deny the hits and the window holds.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit (E): 16s at rank 1, his only escape — but Lightslinger attacks shorten it, so deny the double-shots. - Lightslinger fires after every ABILITY cast: the cast is your cue, not the attack. - The Culling: 110s.

notes: Lightslinger also empowers his next two attacks whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilized. Needlework only slows, so it should not trigger that — but the kit file does not define whether a slow counts as immobilized, so I did not write it either way.
